etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Middle English lyftyme, equivalent to life +‎ time. Cognate with Icelandic líftími (“lifetime”). Compare also Saterland Frisian Lieuwendstied, Dutch leeftijd and levenstijd, German Low German Levenstied, German Lebenszeit, Danish livstid, Swedish livstid.

definitions.definition: The duration of the life of someone or something.
(informal, hyperbolic) A long period of time.
